questions.prompt: The hungry soldiers eat the bread which the farmer had given them.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs ēsurientēs pānem edunt quem agricola eīs dederat.

questions.prompt: While the guests were reclining, they eagerly ate the roasted fish.
questions.answer: Dum convīvae recumbēbant, piscem assum avidē ēdērunt.

questions.prompt: I eat little, but at the banquet I drink much wine.
questions.answer: Parum edō, sed in convīviō multum vīnum bibō.

questions.prompt: The greedy old man had consumed all the honey by himself.
questions.answer: Senex avārus tōtum mel sōlus comēderat.

questions.prompt: Let the weary travelers eat, so that they may regain their strength.
questions.answer: Edant fessī viātōrēs, ut vīrēs recuperent.

questions.prompt: Whatever the gods send, we eat with grateful hearts.
questions.answer: Quidquid dī mittunt, grātīs animīs edimus.

questions.prompt: If you were eating with us, you would be much happier.
questions.answer: Sī nōbīscum ēssēs, multō laetior essēs.

questions.prompt: The little birds eat the seeds scattered across the field.
questions.answer: Avēs parvae sēmina per agrum sparsa edunt.

questions.prompt: She ate the sweet apples plucked from the highest branch.
questions.answer: Māla dulcia ex summō rāmō carpta ēdit.

questions.prompt: Eat this, so that you may not be hungry on the journey.
questions.answer: Hoc ēstō, nē in itinere ēsuriās.

questions.prompt: The soldiers used to eat standing, holding their weapons in their hands.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs stantēs edēbant, arma manibus tenentēs.

questions.prompt: Let us eat and rejoice, for tomorrow remains uncertain.
questions.answer: Edāmus et laetēmur, nam crās incertum manet.

questions.prompt: You all eat more than you are able to carry away.
questions.answer: Plūs ēstis quam auferre potestis.

questions.prompt: When the wolf had consumed the lamb, it fled into the forest.
questions.answer: Cum lupus agnum comēdisset, in silvam fūgit.

questions.prompt: We were eating dinner when a sudden messenger arrived.
questions.answer: Cēnam edēbāmus, cum subitus nūntius advēnit.

questions.prompt: Eat, guest, whatever pleases you at this table.
questions.answer: Ēs, hospes, quidquid tibi in hāc mēnsā placet.

questions.prompt: They will eat the harvest gathered with great toil.
questions.answer: Messem magnō labōre collēctam edent.

questions.prompt: May you eat with joy the gifts of the generous host.
questions.answer: Dōna hospitis largī cum gaudiō edās.

questions.prompt: The consul, once dinner had been eaten, hurried to the senate.
questions.answer: Cōnsul, cēnā ēsā, ad senātum properāvit.

questions.prompt: Nothing is eaten in the temple during the sacred days.
questions.answer: Nihil in templō sacrīs diēbus ēstur.

questions.prompt: If they should eat these mushrooms, they would surely die.
questions.answer: Sī hōs fungōs ēssent, certē morerentur.
